# Page 1
SCHEDULE 3
(Form 1040) 2025 Additional Credits and Payments
Header: Part I Nonrefundable Credits
- 1: Foreign tax credit
- 6z: Other nonrefundable credits. List type and amount
- 7: Total other nonrefundable credits. Add lines 6a through 6z
- 8: Add lines 1 through 4, 5a, 5b, and 7
Header: Part II Other Payments and Refundable Credits
- 9: Net premium tax credit
- 13z: Other refundable credits. List type and amount
- 14: Total other payments or refundable credits. Add lines 13a through 13z
- 15: Add lines 9 through 12 and 14
